Content:
@everyone 📢 LibreLane Update!

This update includes important changes to LibreLane, as well as some general PDK updates. Below is a list of the most noteworthy changes.

- PDK [`2fdf40d5`](https://github.com/fossi-foundation/open-pdks/commit/2fdf40d5736413bb321c31418462aefc17b919b8)
  - Update magic and netgen tech files
  - Update `gf180mcu_ocd_sc_rt12t3v3` to latest
  - Update gf180mcu_as_sc_mcu7t3v3 to latest
  - Fix RC constants (resistance unit mismatch of 1e3): https://github.com/fossi-foundation/open-pdks/pull/582

- Project Template [1.6.1](https://github.com/wafer-space/gf180mcu-project-template/releases/tag/1.6.1)
  - Update PDK to 2fdf40d5
  - Update LibreLane
    - Fix SPEF annotation of macros: https://github.com/librelane/librelane/issues/1075

- Precheck [1.8.1](https://github.com/wafer-space/gf180mcu-precheck/releases/tag/1.8.1)
  - Update PDK to 2fdf40d5
  - Add more layer checks to prevent surprises later on (`ESD`, `FuseWindow_D`, `POLYFUSE`, `GUARD_RING_MK`)

Despite the unit mismatch in the RC constants, there were no significant changes to the LibreLane CI metrics.
Note that the final parasitics for post-pnr STA are extracted using OpenRCX and were not affected by this mismatch.

Please let me know if there are any questions.
